• 你创造了三个扭曲着的，尖啸着的，低过敏的，无麸质的魔法立场飞镖。每一枚飞弹都瞄准一个在施法距离内由你选择的可见生物。为每一枚飞弹进行远程攻击检定。若命中，飞弹将对这个目标造成2d4点力场伤害。

context: column:M;spell:Jim's Magic Missile;book:艾奎兹玄有限责任公司;level:1
target:
• Every wizard's apprentice can cast that boring old relic, Magic Missile. Oh, yes, it always hits. (Yawn.) Stop doing the chores handed down by your grandfather and use this improved version, just like Jim Darkmagic!
• You create three twisting, shrieking, hypoallergenic, gluten-free darts of magical force. Each dart targets a visible creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged attack roll for each dart. On a hit, a dart deals 2d4 force damage to its target.
• If an attack roll scores a critical hit, that dart deals 5d4 force damage to its target instead of rolling the damage dice twice as for a normal critical hit. However, if any dart's attack roll is a 1, all the darts miss their targets and explode in your face. Each dart then deals 1 damage to you.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, it creates one additional dart for each slot level above 1st, but the royalty component also increases by 1 gp per additional level.

• This spell lets you use an animal to carry a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, blue jay, or bat. Choose a location you have visited, then describe the recipient in general terms, such as a man or woman wearing a town guard's uniform, or a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat. Finally, speak a message of no more than 25 words. The target beast travels toward the chosen location for the spell's duration. A flying messenger can travel 50 li in 24 hours; a messenger that cannot fly can travel only 25 li.
• When the messenger reaches its destination, it imitates your voice to deliver the message to the person you described. It delivers the message only to someone matching that description. If it does not reach the destination before the spell's duration expires, the message is lost, and the beast that served as messenger finds its own way back to where you cast the spell.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

note: Full passage translated; Tiny beast, recipient description, 25-word limit, delivery failure, and 48-hour scaling checked. The source uses li for the 50/25 travel distances, so that unit is retained rather than silently replaced with miles.

• 施法时，指定施法距离内一处你能看见的点。再令一束闪电从云端射向该点。在该点5尺内的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到3d10点闪电伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。直至法术终止前，你都可以在自己回合内使用动作再次发射闪电，并在攻击前指定同一点或另选一点。
• 若施法时你身处室外暴风雨环境，则此法术令你得以控制空中的暴雨云而非创一朵新雷云。且法术伤害增加1d10。
• 升环施法效应：使用4环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比3环高一环，法术的伤害就增加1d10。
target:
• Choose a point you can see in the air 100 feet above you. A storm cloud forms there in a cylinder 10 feet high with a radius of 60 feet. The spell fails if you cannot see a location in the air where the cloud could form, such as when you are in a room that is not tall enough.
• When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see within range and call a bolt of lightning from the cloud to that point. Creatures within 5 feet of the point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, you can use your action on your turn to call down another bolt, choosing the same point or a different one before the strike.
• If you are outdoors in a storm when you cast the spell, you take control of the existing storm clouds instead of creating a new cloud, and the spell's damage increases by 1d10.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

• 你做一个使人平静的手势，在施法距离内，你选择最多3名你可以看见的自愿生物在法术持续时间中进入昏迷状态。如果生物受到伤害或者某人使用动作将他摇醒，对于那个目标法术会提前结束。如果目标在整个持续期间都保持昏迷，目标会得到一次短休的增益，但是在完成一次长休之前将不能再受到该法术的影响。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用4环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每高一环，你就可以多指定一个额外的自愿生物作为目标。
target:
• With a soothing gesture, you choose up to three willing creatures you can see within range and cause them to become unconscious for the duration. The spell ends early for a target if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake. If a target remains unconscious for the entire duration, it gains the benefits of a short rest, but cannot be affected by this spell again until it finishes a long rest.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can choose one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

• 你在施法距离内某处创造一个隐形的传感器，该处可以是你熟悉的地点（你曾到访过或看见过的地方），也可以是你不熟悉的显眼处（比如一扇门后，拐角位置或树林里）。该传感器在法术持续时间内停留在该地且无法被攻击或与之互动。
• 施展该法术时，你可以选择进行观察或是聆听。你可以通过传感器以所选的感官方式感测目标空间。你也可以用一个动作在观察和聆听之间切换。
• 可以看见传感器的生物（比如生物具有增益如看破隐形 See Invisibility或真实视觉时）会看到检测点是一个拳头大小发着微光的半透球体。
target:
• You create an invisible sensor at a location within range. The location can be familiar to you, somewhere you have visited or seen, or an obvious unfamiliar location, such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees. The sensor remains there for the duration and cannot be attacked or otherwise interacted with.
• When you cast the spell, choose sight or hearing. You perceive the target space through the sensor using the chosen sense. You can use an action to switch between seeing and hearing.
• A creature able to see the sensor, such as one benefiting from See Invisibility or truesight, sees a faintly glowing, translucent sphere about the size of a fist at its location.
